statement: ∀ (s δ η : ℝ), δ ≤ η → GP.content s η E ≤ GP.content s δ E
proof:
intro s δ η hδη
unfold GP.content
refine le_iInf fun U => le_iInf fun hU => ?_
have hUη : GP.Cover E η U := ⟨hU.1, fun i => (hU.2 i).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hδη)⟩
exact iInf_le_of_le U (iInf_le_of_le hUη le_rfl)
